review.reason: The patch adds two bounded capability improvements: it extends warehouse ingestion support by configuring two new CMC derivative liquidation endpoints and updates pagination checks accordingly. This demonstrates a substantive, localized enhancement whose relevant configuration and test expectations are visible. It does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction across components, so tier 3 is unsupported.
review.posthog_relevance: These configurations could enable PostHog’s warehouse connector to ingest fresh derivatives liquidation signals from CoinMarketCap, potentially supporting downstream analytics on crypto market stress. The benefit depends on whether this connector is used in production and how those tables are consumed; the diff alone cannot establish actual adoption or incident avoidance.
review.uncertainty: This chunk omits runtime execution, database migrations, tests for row content and any release notes establishing customer usage. Tier assignment relies solely on configuration and pagination assertions.
